app_fee.value: USD 90 non-refundable fee for each program applied to, for degree-seeking applicants.
app_fee.quote: Degree Seeking, $90.00 | Application fees are non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate College does not waive fees itself; waivers exist only for participants of approved sponsored programs (via a verification letter) or where a department grants one.
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate College does not waive application fees.

also.quote: This webform is utilized to submit a verification letter to confirm the participation of an applicant in one of the sponsored programs that is approved for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The Graduate College sets no GRE requirement; each program decides (see program records).

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 79 for tests before Jan 21, 2026, or 4.0 overall on the new 1-6 scale for tests on or after that date. Individual programs may set higher scores; Duolingo not accepted.
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken prior to January 21, 2026: Minimum score of 79 iBT or Home Edition iBT. | For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: Minimum overall score of 4.0 on the TOEFL 1-6 scale.

ielts_min.value: IELTS composite 7 with no subject area below 6.
ielts_min.quote: minimum composite score of 7, with no subject area below a 6

english_waiver.value: The Graduate College exempts citizens of countries where English is an official language, and its country table lists India as test required: No. Check with your program; the physics page words the rule as proof required unless you hold a US degree.
english_waiver.quote: Those exempt from submitting English proficiency scores are: | Applicants who hold citizenship from countries where English is an official language.
